newsitem.title: USA: Reddi Brake sees Q1 loss, seeks extension.
newsitem.headline: Reddi Brake sees Q1 loss, seeks extension.

text.p: Reddi Brake Supply Corp Friday said it expected to report a $2 million loss for the first quarter ended in September and has filed a request with the U.S.Securities and Exchange Commission for an extension in reporting its results.

The company said in a statement it reached an arrangement with its principal trade creditors, under which they agreed to grant Reddi Brake a moratorium of at least 30 days. They also selected a creditors' committee to monitor the repayment program and agreed to continue providing goods and services to the company on a creditor-by-creditor basis.

Reddi Brake attributed the loss to a decline in gross margins to 36 percent from 42 percent in the year ago quarter when the company reported a loss of $103,000, or $0.01 a share, on sales of $15.3 million.
Reddi Brake said it expects sales for the three months ended September 30, 1996 to rise to $16.7 million.

The year ago quarter's gross margins were heavily influenced by free of highly discounted merchandise provided by vendors, the company said. The expected loss was also attributable to an increase in selling and warehouse expenses.
"The anticipated sales growth was not achieved due primarliy to a lack of optimum inventory availability," the company said.
